3_image_token_alignment.note: The real trainer's _get_per_token_logps applies no shift to t2i/image tokens (unlike the mm2t/text branch, which explicitly shifts logits/input_ids); source re-read at grpo_trainer_unified.py:350-424 confirmed this. The probe's 'correct' computation reproduces the real unshifted trainer behavior exactly. The empirical result (shifted-by-one control logp slightly higher than the unshifted logp) is recorded honestly as measured, at n=8 records; most likely explained by small sample size and/or local spatial correlation in the 24x24 VQ token grid weakening the shift-by-one control's discriminative power, not by a probe defect. This finding does not change the source-code fact (no shift applied) which is the primary object of this check.

4_batched_mc_oe_reward_dispatch.summary: common_qa_accuracy_reward's batched dispatch on qa_type make the MC branch structurally unreachable when mixed with OE examples in one batch; confirmed via a synthetic MC/OE example run directly against the real function in the pinned CoRL venv (see configs/corl/admission/discrepancy-lock.yaml D14 for full evidence and reproduction steps). The actual 32-record micro-split contains 32/32 qa_type=OE records (no MC examples exist in this micro-split), so this defect was not separately re-triggered by the GPU smoke run itself; it was demonstrated by the dedicated synthetic probe referenced above.

6_reward_range_zero_variance_clipping.clipping_note: compute_loss's per-token ratio is (logps - old_logps).exp() with no torch.clamp; epsilon_low/epsilon_high are stored on the trainer but never read inside compute_loss (confirmed by full source re-read). Clipping structurally cannot occur in this trainer regardless of ratio magnitude.

8_upstream_exact_vs_corrected_candidate_.upstream_exact_error_summary: GRPOScriptArguments.model_ckpt_dir default literal 'XXX/checkpoint/' concatenated by T2ICycleConsistencyReward.load_external_model to 'XXX/checkpoint//all-mpnet-base-v2', which is not a valid HF repo id or local path -- exactly the documented upstream defect (see discrepancy-lock.yaml, model.auxiliary_models note in source-lock.yaml).
